feat.name: Sin of Pride

otherSummary.entry: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat
otherSummary.entrySummary: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Pride, carrying within you the power and arrogance of Lucifer. This manifestation grants you supernatural resilience, an imposing presence, and the ability to reject any outcome that would place you beneath another.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Pride
entries: You embody superiority and perfection. You have Advantage on Intimidation checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Lucifer
entries: Your mind is unyielding, and your ego refuses to be broken. You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

entries.name: Never Be Wrong
entries: When you take damage, are hit by an attack, or fail a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to reject that outcome. You can use this feature to protect yourself from damage or an attack. You take half damage that triggered this feature.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: You take no damage and suffer no other effects from the attack or damage that triggered this feature.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: You can now use Sin of Lucifer when you fail a saving throw. You instead succeed on that saving throw, suffering no effects that would occur as a result of failing it.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: When you use Sin of Lucifer to negate an attack or the effects of a failed saving throw, you can cause the effect to be reflected back upon its source.

If you reflect an attack, the attack is resolved against its original attacker, using the same attack roll and comparing it against the attacker's AC. The attacker can still make any saving throw normally allowed by the attack.
If you reflect the effects of a failed saving throw, the creature that caused the saving throw must instead suffer the effects of that failed save.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: When you use Sin of Lucifer to negate an attack or the effects of a failed saving throw, the creature that caused the triggering effect takes an extra 1d6 Psychic damage for each level you have.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: You regain the use of Sin of Lucifer when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Additionally, at the start of each of your turns, roll 1d6. On a roll of 6, you regain the use of Sin of Lucifer.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: When you reflect an attack using Sin of Lucifer, you can choose one of the following effects:

items: The reflected attack is a Critical Hit.
The target automatically fails any saving throw caused by the reflected attack, and the attack deals the maximum damage instead of rolling its damage dice.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: When you die, you can use Sin of Lucifer to reject your death. You return to life with Hit Points equal to half your Hit Point maximum, and you suffer no negative effects from dying. The creature that caused your death takes Psychic damage equal to the total damage you took during the current turn.
You can use Sin of Lucifer even if you are unconscious or otherwise unable to take actions or reactions.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: After you use Sin of Lucifer, you gain Immunity to all damage and all conditions until the end of your next turn.
Additionally, the extra Psychic damage dealt by Sin of Lucifer changes from 1d6 per level you have to 1d12 per level you have.

feat.name: Sin of Greed

otherSummary.entry: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat
otherSummary.entrySummary: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Greed, carrying within you the boundless avarice and insatiable hunger of Mammon. This manifestation grants you supernatural resilience, a covetous presence, and the power to claim that which you desire as your own.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Greed
entries: You embody insatiable desire and avarice, driven to possess anything of value. You have Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Mammon
entries: Your desire to possess and control manifests as an unyielding force. You have Resistance to Force damage.

entries.name: Everything Is Mine
entries: When a creature you can see casts a spell, you can use your Reaction to prepare that spell. You retain the prepared spell until you finish a Long Rest.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: The creature that cast the triggering spell must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the spell has no effect, and the creature regains the Spell Slot expended to cast it.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: The target automatically fails the saving throw, and the creature doesn't regain the Spell Slot expended to cast it.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: The triggering effect no longer needs to be a spell. You can steal any spell or feature of a creature you can see, causing the spell or feature to have no effect. The creature doesn't regain any resource expended to use the stolen spell or feature.

After you steal a spell or feature, you gain the benefits of the stolen spell or feature. If the stolen effect is a spell or an activated feature, you can use it once without expending any resources. You retain the stolen spell or feature until you steal another spell or feature, and it doesn't disappear when you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: The number of spells or features you can steal and retain at the same time increases by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus. You can replace any spell or feature you currently retain whenever you steal a new spell or feature.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: You regain the use of Sin of Mammon when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Additionally, at the start of each of your turns, roll 1d6. On a roll of 6, you regain the use of Sin of Mammon.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: After you steal a spell or feature, the creature that cast the spell or used the feature can't use that spell or feature again until it finishes a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: You can target the corpse of a creature or the soul of a creature if its soul still exists to steal one spell or feature that creature possessed. You gain the benefits of the stolen spell or feature as though you had stolen it using Sin of Mammon.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: There is no limit to the number of spells or activated features you can retain at the same time.

feat.name: Sin of Lust

otherSummary.entry: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat
otherSummary.entrySummary: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Lust, carrying within you the irresistible temptation and overwhelming desire of Asmodeus. This manifestation grants you supernatural resilience, an enchanting presence, and the power to awaken absolute devotion in the hearts of others.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Devil Inside
entries: You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Demonic Lore
entries: The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Lust
entries: You embody irresistible beauty and desire, causing others to become drawn toward you. You have Advantage on Persuasion checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Asmodeus
entries: Your voice carries the irresistible temptation of Asmodeus, and your body has adapted to withstand the power of sound itself. You have Resistance to Thunder damage.

entries.name: Love Only Me
entries: As an Action, choose one creature you can see within range.
The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or have the Charmed condition for 1 hour.
While affected, the creature regards you as a trusted companion and will speak in a friendly manner and am happy to accommodate your small requests.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: The duration increases to 8 hours.
The creature regards you as one of its closest companions and deeply trusts you. willingly accepts requests that don't directly harm itself or violate its core beliefs.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: The duration increases to 1 day.
The creature considers you one of the important people in its life and refuses to knowingly harm you.
It willingly accepts requests that cause it personal inconvenience or minor losses.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: The duration increases to 7 days.
The creature becomes devoted to you. It willingly places itself in danger to protect you and accepts requests involving reasonable personal risk.
If another creature threatens you, it instinctively attempts to defend you before considering its own safety.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: The duration increases to 1 month.
The creature's affection becomes obsession.
It can no longer willingly act against your interests and accepts requests that provide no benefit to itself or require great personal sacrifice.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: The duration increases to 1 year.
You regain the use of Love Only Me when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Additionally, At the start of each of your turns, roll 1d6. On a roll of 6, you regain the use of Love Only Me.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: The duration increases to 10 years.
You become the most important person in the creature's life.
It is willing to risk its life, betray allies, abandon loyalties, reject its beliefs, and sacrifice treasured possessions if doing so benefits you.

Additionally, If the creature is immune to being Charmed or immune to magical effects that influence the mind, it must still make the Charisma saving throw against Love Only Me normally. On a failed save, this feature ignores that immunity.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: The duration increases to 100 years.
The creature's devotion becomes absolute.
It willingly sacrifices its life, soul, memories, or anything else it possesses if you command it to do so.
Additionally, A creature targeted by Love Only Me automatically fails saving throws against this feature.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: The duration becomes permanent.
Love Only Me no longer charms or magically compels its target.
Instead, it permanently rewrites the creature's desires, emotions, and loyalties.
The creature genuinely believes that its devotion toward you is its own free will, and this effect isn't considered being Charmed, magically compelled, or under mind control.
